measure: Hydrogen peroxide propylene oxide (HPPO) process instead of conventional PO process
note: "about 35% lower than the conventional process"; including hydrogen peroxide production the chain saving is about 10-12%. Commercial plants: 100 kt Ulsan, 300 kt Antwerp, 390 kt Thailand.

measure: Catalytic naphtha cracking instead of steam cracking
note: Energy savings of 10-20% vs steam cracking (reprinted from Ren, Patel and Blok 2006); about 20% less than the world-average steam cracker; replacing older crackers could save 30-40%.
